evidence.limit: Synthetic Chromium microphone; no physical device/audio routing or audible quality evidence.

checks.name: Full downloaded backup restores real recording bytes additively
checks.evidence: Two imported copies plus existing sample; original dates and audio SHA-256 preserved through restore/reload.

checks.name: Additive v1→v3 database migration preserves legacy text/audio
checks.evidence: Real IndexedDB upgrade preserved fixture identity/text/bytes and added sessions; fixture audio is arbitrary bytes, not playable media.

checks.name: Denied microphone leaves a usable notebook
checks.evidence: Chromium context without a microphone grant rejected capture; editing and saving remained available.

checks.name: Version-2 library keeps original fields and audio through upgrade
checks.evidence: Version-2 fixture retains identity, dates, settings, take identity and audio through upgrade, edit and reload.

checks.name: Final-save storage fault retains audio and recovery checkpoint
checks.evidence: Injected persistence failure, not an actual full disk; audio stayed in memory and journal recovered exactly once on reload.

checks.name: Stale tab cannot overwrite newer lyrics or recordings
checks.evidence: Stale save rejected; newer lyrics/audio survive; a downloaded backup preserves the stale tab’s unsaved tag.

checks.name: Queued edits in one tab remain saveable
checks.evidence: Own queued saves advance safely without a false cross-tab conflict.

checks.name: An older save cannot confirm newer unsaved text
checks.evidence: Completion of an earlier write does not label later unsaved edits as saved.

checks.name: A stale tab cannot recreate a deleted idea
checks.evidence: Deletion remains durable; stale text is available for explicit export without silently resurrecting the idea.

checks.name: Journal for a deleted idea recovers as an idempotent new copy
checks.evidence: Original ID stays deleted; available journal bytes recover to one new idea and do not duplicate on reopen.
